summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several technical issues, starting with a data ingestion failure where an aggregation dataset was lost due to a script calling the process twice (once for production and once for staging). The issue required manual restoration of the production environment.

A major discussion point involved migrating ETL jobs from Rundeck to a more modern scheduler. While [me] noted that rewriting all jobs would be complex, [p1] suggested using Airflow or Mage. Ultimately, due to internal requests (from someone named Galina), the decision was made to proceed with setting up and gradually moving tasks into Airflow.

Separately, discussions covered data architecture, including confirming that real-time data is expected on ClickHouse in the near future, requiring documentation of this capability.
decisions: The team will migrate ETL jobs from Rundeck to Airflow.
Airflow was confirmed as the preferred scheduling tool due to internal requirements.
action_items: Continue migrating tasks into Airflow from Rundeck.
Document the expected real-time data capabilities on ClickHouse.
